name: Haar Wavelet Compression
aliases: 3D Haar Wavelet Compression with Random Access
3D Haar Wavelet Compression with Random Access (Ihm and Park)
Wavelet-Based 3D Volume Compression with Fast Random Access
definition: A method where the volume is partitioned into small blocks which are further subdivided into subblocks. Subblocks are transformed with a three-dimensional Haar wavelet applied two or three times. Coefficients are then quantized and encoded.
